items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I used to let a lot of the bands use our sleeper bus. Run into a band like Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins and all of them.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, it was -- because -- yeah, no, it wasn't --
But, I mean, when you come down to it, I mean, there was -- it was a good reason for people disliking Lester's tone, because, I mean, Cohn and Hawkins had sort of shown what the instrument could do.
